paragraphs: Here's my big idea, friend: you are not a leftover. Paul says God chose us in Christ before the foundation of the world (Ephesians 1:4), and that He predestined us for adoption as His sons through Jesus Christ (Ephesians 1:5). I spent years in the back of a drawer thinking I was an afterthought, and Paul says the people of God were on His heart before there was a world to put a drawer in. That's not a plan He came up with at the last minute, and it's not an accident.

Now look at what it cost and how He gave it. "In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of His grace that He lavished on us" (Ephesians 1:7-8). Lavished, friend! Not rationed, not handed out with a coupon. God didn't give you a pinch of grace and tell you to make it last, so you don't have to stand at the oven doing grace math.

And you've got a down payment already. You heard the word of truth, believed it, and were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit, who is "the pledge of our inheritance" (Ephesians 1:13-14). So you can rest in what He's already done and still look forward to what's coming. All of it lands where Paul keeps landing, on "the praise of His glory" (Ephesians 1:14), which means this life isn't about proving yourself. It's about being so loved that your whole life ends up pointing back to Him.
